newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zairean rebels enter Lubumbashi - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Zairean rebels enter Lubumbashi - witnesses.

text.p: Zairean rebels of Laurent Kabila entered the country's second city and mining capital Lubumbashi on Wednesday, witnesses said.

They said that after a bout of heavy gunfire a dozen rebels wearing dark olive fatigues, black berets and wellington boots reached a hotel near to the military headquarters and some three kilometres (two miles) south of the city centre.

Residents in downtown Lubumbashi, capital of Zaire's rich copper region, said by telephone that the rebels had yet to reach the centre of the city of a million people. There were no signs of looting, they said.
As the rebels entered the suburbs from the south, crowds cheered and chanted "Kabila, Kabila".
Residents in the area of army headquarters said that about 30 minutes before the rebels arrived amid heavy gunfire, a vehicle carrying army generals and other soldiers had sped north.
The road north goes into the city centre or to the airport, about six km (four miles) distant.
